title: Finish content-based pr_commits classification and fix reconcile fallout
summary: Retry the content-based pr_commits rewrite in land.rs, this time also updating every dependent caller and fixture (reconcile.rs tests, athena-cli reconcile tests, gh.rs, run.rs retry_landing) and using the specified operator/ nested-gitattributes fixture. Audience: Sri and the verifier, who run athena-core and athena-cli reconcile tests.

defaults_applied.how: Run athena-core, athena-cli reconcile tests, clippy, fmt.
Criteria run tests asserting kinds and sha-named errors.
Audit all callers and writers of landing records.
Doc comments and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: finish content-based classification in pr_commits so athena land --pr accepts real PRs; audience Sri and the verifier.
Reconcile fixtures (core and CLI) are shared with the realistic fixture where feasible; fixture updated to follow new rules is acceptable if stated.
Prior deliverables (land.rs, gh.rs, invariant.rs, docs, CHANGELOG) still apply, plus reconcile.rs tests and athena-cli tests/reconcile.rs.
Callers beyond those found by grep (e.g. run.rs) are checked by the producer.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. All pass, including land:: tests: a realistic range (reading, dispatch, introspection commits, an operator/ lease commit with nested operator/.gitattributes '* athena-exclude' named in the test doc comment, an intervention adding records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json, then a job's candidate, verification and outcome; no Athena-Job trailers) yields records_only x4, declared_intervention, job_landing with that job and verification id.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Blocked-then-landed: a commit adding candidate, verification and a blocked outcome is records_only; a later commit adding only outcome-landed.json plus governed work is job_landing for that job, reusing the gate's closing_jobs logic.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core land::`. Refusal tests each make pr_commits return an error containing the commit's sha: governed change that is neither intervention nor closing records; landing with no verification; landing whose outcome is not landed; operator/ commit without the exclusion.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core reconcile::` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test reconcile`. The 5 core and 2 CLI reconcile tests pass; the change description says whether fixtures or code were changed and why.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh::`. Landing commits carry kind/job/verification from pr_commits and pass LandingCommit::validate.

pr_commits and PrCommit no longer read trailers or mention Athena-Job; doc comments state the content rules and that closing_jobs is the single source of truth. Old trailer-count tests are removed. Empty range is still an error.

Change description lists every caller of pr_commits and every writer of landing records (gh.rs, run.rs retry_landing, reconcile.rs via GitLandingRecords) with the test covering each, and cites commands actually run.
docs/design/records-history.md and CHANGELOG.md describe content-based classification and no longer describe the trailer rule.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`; both clean.

out_of_scope: Changing the gate's fingerprint or closing_jobs semantics beyond exposing them for reuse
departures: Wider scope (reconcile fixtures, CLI tests) and a prior failed attempt raise cost and lower pass odds.
